address: 7-9 Sandford Road, Ranelagh, Dublin City, D06 E2H7, Ireland
bio: Lively, loud and simply wonderful fun, Parrilla offers both a great night out in Dublin and lightning-fast transport to Mexico in one appealing package. As soon as you arrive, it gives off ‘hottest ticket in town’ energy, combining a pumping soundtrack with a room full of smiles from the team and guests alike. Start off with a margarita before choosing from a menu dominated by its taco and grill selections – although don’t miss out on the padron peppers with red pepper salsa or the generous crab tostada too. If you’re in a group, ask for one of the booths.
